notes.title: Chapter 2 of Nephilim Resurrection released TODAY!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Chapter 2 of Nephilim Resurrection is LIVE! 🚀 We’re beyond excited to share this huge update with you. Your support and feedback have been incredible, and we’re thrilled to see our community grow. If you haven’t joined our Discord yet, now’s the perfect time to jump in and help shape the future of the game!

JOIN THE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/NbgFPycPRQ

This update is packed with new content, and it’s all free! Just download the patch and you’re good to go. Plus, we’re dropping a brand new EP with an OST that will accompany the second chapter. If you loved the epic sounds of Book of the Lyrin, you’re in for a treat. Turn up the volume and enjoy some killer tunes!

LISTEN ON SPOTIFY: https://open.spotify.com/album/7LQt3N0uOWHQCea2rrWVFm

We’re all about building a strong community, and we need your help to make Nephilim Resurrection the best it can be. Your feedback, reviews, and content creation are crucial. Share your thoughts, tell your friends, and let’s make some noise together!

For those of you who purchased in Early Access, thank you for believing in us and supporting our indie team. We couldn’t do this without you!

Now, let’s dive into the exciting new features of Chapter 2:

New Maps

[list]
[*]TUNNELS OF MASHU: Navigate the labyrinth and transition from the old world to the new.
[*]FORTRESS OF HUBUR: Explore a mechanical fortress filled with acid – what secrets lie beneath?
[*]EANNA HEIGHTS: Confront your fears atop the city and destroy the nightmares.
[*]THE CREMATION GROUNDS: Face our superboss at the end – she’s not taking any prisoners.
[/list]

New Weapons

[list]
[*]8-Shot Rifle: Fewer bullets, but packs a punch – perfect for heavy damage.
[*]Flame Sceptre: Unleash fiery wrath on your enemies. It’s like a Sceptre on steroids.
[*]Dual Revolvers: Double the firepower, double the fun. Insane armour penetration, but you’ll need to reload both.
[/list]

New Abilities

[list]
[*]Blazing Wings: Deal AoE damage every time you jump.
[*]Teeth: Recover a small amount of HP with each hit.
[*]Shield: Use stamina instead of health until it’s depleted.
[*]Whale Charm: Take significantly less damage while underwater.
[/list]

We hope you’re as pumped as we are about these new additions. Thanks again for your support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

Jay from AP x

notes.title: Chapter 2 Launched
notes.content:
Nephilim Resurrection's second chapter brings 3 brand new fully developed locations and 1 more super boss to the retro FPS from Arrogant Pixel. These come alongside 3 new weapons and 4 more special abilities, providing even more ways to destroy Cultists en masse. It also has a thunderous new soundtrack from our in-house metal band, who have cut up the rulebook and produced an OST that is frankly disgusting.

[b]New Maps[/b]

[list]
[*] TUNNELS OF MASHU - Transition from the old world to the new via the labyrinth.
[*] FORTRESS OF HUBUR - A mechanical fortress filled with terrible acid - what what lurks beneath?
[*] EANNA HEIGHTS - Upon the city top, disquiet grows. Take a leap of faith and destroy the stuff of nightmares.
[*] THE CREMATION GROUNDS - At the end, our superboss awaits - and she takes no prisoners.
[/list]

[b]New Weapons[/b]

[list]
[*] 8-Shot Rifle: Fewer bullets, but packs more of a punch - great for dealing heavy damage to big health bars
[*] Flame Sceptre: Bring fire down upon your enemies. Hits like a normal Sceptre on speed.
[*] Dual Revolvers: If you're a fan of the Revolver, can I sell you on two of them? Insane armour penetration at the cost of reloading both...
[/list]

[b]New Abilities[/b]

[list]
[*] Blazing Wings: Deal AoE damage around you every time you jump
[*] Teeth: Recover a small amount of HP upon hit
[*] Shield: Drains stamina instead of health, until stamina is empty
[*] Whale Charm: Take significantly less damage while underwater.
[/list]

Does this mean that all of the bugs are ironed out of the game? Gods no. We've arguably put more in. That's where you come in! Join our Discord server today and let us know what problems you run into, and what you want to see more of in... CHAPTER 3.

[h1]Update 0.4.1 Beta Release[/h1]

https://youtu.be/RguSpwM521Q

Hi everyone! Thank you to everyone who provided feedback on this patch during beta, if you are interested in getting access to the beta branch, join our discord server -> discord.gg/UKyWYqe


We're excited to share our new free update to Nephilim Resurrection. 0.4.1 is the Endless Mode update, featuring a new rotation of special game modes to play daily with unique scoreboards. Players will be able to access the 0.4.1 update today, with more improvements incoming soon.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
- Improvements to Endless Mode, including 2 brand new game modes: Tap the Button and Modifier.
- [b]Tap the Button:[/b] between waves, between 1-4 buttons will light up that must be pressed before the end of the round. This demands players to move around the map quickly while managing the increasing difficulty of the enemy waves.
- [b]Modifier:[/b]  each wave generates a new modifier that is placed on the player, increasing the difficulty or changing the nature of the challenge. Mods include: night mode (the lights all go out), big jumps (jump momentum x3!), and health drain (ticking damage to player health) - but there are more to find, and more to come!
- [b]Tap X Mod:[/b] Not only do we have these 2 new game modes, but Tap X Mod is a combination new game mode which features both simulataneously! This is by far our hardest game mode so far, and we're looking forward to seeing your best scores.
- [b]New Scoreboards:[/b]  Each of these levels will have unique scoreboards, so players can compete for greatness across each game mode individually.
- [b]Endless Rotation:[/b] And each of these Endless Game Modes are available on the beta branch on daily rotation right NOW!

[h2]Other Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed health bug where double damage was applied for the hit where armour was broken.
- Fixed relic stacking so players can collect relics multiple times.

[b]Remember:[/b] Nephilim Resurrection is an early access game - so we want to hear your feedback! Get in touch via the feedback form in-game or join our Discord to chat with us directly - as it's also the best place to hear news on the upcoming major content updates (which you'll be hearing more about soon!)

Thanks again for your support - AP Team

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix #4[/b]

Thank you for everyone who has given us feedback and played so far! We have made several changes to improve the tutorial, making the first level a little bit easier and general changes to make the game less punishing.

[b]Tutorial Level[/b]

- Shadow boss damage output and health reduced.
- Tablet tooltips added to explain some game mechanics.
- Portal added to tutorial.

[b]Shanidar Cave[/b]

- Yalkido damage and health reduced.
- Portals in boss fight spawn rate increased and enemy types made easier.
- Some collision issues resolved in first fight chamber.

[b]General[/b]

- If die during a run, you will now keep the relics you have collected!
- Trap projectiles now do significantly less damage.
- Interaction text moved to the top of the screen as not to obscure gameplay.
- Door audio now releasing properly after restarting a level.
- Several levels now have colliders at the top to prevent players standing on the top of the levels or jumping into the infinite void.
- Changed default values for crosshairs.
- Some audio performance improvements for torches when turned off but not removed from the scene.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content: - New users will now have their cross hairs visible by default.

notes.title: 0.4.0 (Hotfix #2)
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has given suggestions and shown bugs through our discord or by discussing with us live! We have made some changes based on your suggestions:

[b]General Notes[/b]
- Levels details panels now a leader board button which will take you to the community leader board for that specific level. This will open in steam overlay.
- Toggle for turning off and on the cross hairs, with adjustable opacity. 
- Weapons have their own unique cross hairs.

[b]Shanidar Cave[/b]
- Kill box for when players get thrown out the level by the boss.
- Jump puzzle portals now start after the cutscene.

[b]Nahla Village[/b]
- Now players should not be able to jump over the cliffs into the infinite void.

[b]Endless Mode[/b]
- The endless mode boss has more health and gives less points.

notes.title: 0.4.0 (Hotfix #1)
notes.content: - We have made the tutorial cultists easier (they should die in one hit)
